description:
[Candidates]

Moves a candidate's application to another position of the company, for a candidate who fits it better. A new application is created for the target, starting at the step you choose (by default the first one after the pre-screening); the steps before it are recorded as skipped. The old application is closed as not selected (no rejection e-mail) unless close_application is false, and both are linked. The candidate is e-mailed once ("Your application has moved", with your message) unless notify_candidate is false. There is no preview. Not for positions linked to an ATS job (move the application in the ATS). Owners and recruiters with access to both positions; hiring managers read only.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

application_id.description: The application to move (an application `id` from get_candidate: list_candidates / get_candidate applications, or list_interview_results).

close_application.description: true: the application is closed as not selected for its position (no rejection e-mail; open steps end, booked meetings and human interview requests are cancelled). An application already closed is only linked.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

message.description: A message to the candidate, shown in the e-mail.

notify_candidate.description: true: the candidate gets the e-mail "Your application has moved" (the company's candidate message settings apply), and the cancellation of a booked meeting.

pre_screening.description: When the target's pre-screening is one of the skipped steps: rescore copies the candidate's CV from this application into it and scores it against the target (the step stays skipped; one pre-screening credit), skip records it as skipped only. A form-only pre-screening is never re-scored.

start_step_id.description: The step of the target position to start at (a step `id`, from get_interview_definition with include=process). Left out or null: the first step after the pre-screening (the first step when the process has no pre-screening, the pre-screening when it is the only step). The steps before it are recorded as skipped ("Moved from <position>"); the candidate gets no e-mail for them.

target_position_id.description: The position of the same company to move the application to (list_interviews with kind positions).

name: Move_an_application_to_another_position
title: Merchant Application Move
